title: 新加坡 AI Xchange 平台助企业共享 AI 应用经验
titleEn: New SG AI Xchange platform helps firms share lessons on adopting and scaling AI
summary: 新加坡推出 SG AI Xchange 平台，帮助企业分享 AI 采纳经验。经济发展局旨在通过连接全球和本地参与者来建设新加坡的 AI 生态。
summaryEn: A new Singapore platform, SG AI Xchange, helps companies share lessons on adopting AI. The Economic Development Board aims to strengthen Singapore's AI ecosystem by connecting global and local players.
speaker: CNA
